note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ROC 2(4), 3, 9, Enforcement Rules 7; A06b ROC 2(4), 3, 9, Enforcement Rules 7; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Taiwan, 2024
sources.said: Person is domiciled in Taiwan and has been resident for 5 continuous years of which at least 183 days annually. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country (unless it is proven that this is impossible for causes not attributable to the person or person is a high-level professional in the technological, economic, educational, cultural, art, sports domain or any other designated domain, serves the interests of the ROC and has been approved by the authorities). ... n.a.
